en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/654@0/d: What themes will you emphasize as you accept the Democratic nomination and begin your campaign?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/657@1/d: As 1916 begins, you have a vacancy to fill on the Supreme Court. Advisors are recommending Louis Brandeis -- a choice that is sure to be controversial. What are your thoughts?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/655@2/d: The Democratic Convention erupted into spontaneous cries of “He kept us out of war!” as you were nominated. Do you plan to campaign on this position, or will you add some nuance to it?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/665@3/d: What motivated you to place Newton Baker on the ticket for your attempt at reelection?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/660@4/d: The forces of Pancho Villa have killed over 30 Americans in separate incidents, and even launched a raid into New Mexico. How will you respond to this, as President?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/684@5/d: Do you support the level of preparedness established by the recent National Defense Act?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/686@6/d: What will your position be on the women's suffrage question as your campaign this fall?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/661@7/d: You have opposed a federal farm credit system in the past, but a Farm Loan Act is being pushed through Congress again this year. Will you support it this time?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/662@8/d: As September approaches, the nation is at serious risk of a national rail strike. What are your plans for dealing with this?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/688@9/d: Do you have any statements to make about the Federal Reserve Act, which established the Federal Reserve in 1913?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/663@10/: Will you sign the Revenue Act of 1916, which would increase the income tax and establish a Tariff Commission?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/658@11/: How much do you plan to highlight the creation of the Federal Trade Commission as an accomplishment during this campaign?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/687@12/: Do you have a position to take on the calls for the prohibition of alcohol as you campaign this fall?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/690@13/: Do you support the Clayton Antitrust Act which was recently passed? Do you believe that unions should be exempted from the antitrust regulations?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/659@14/: Theodore Roosevelt is hitting the campaign trail hard this fall. However, he continues to make bellicose speeches about the war in Europe. Will you attack Roosevelt and Hughes for this?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/664@15/: How much do you plan to push back against Southern obstructionism on a federal child labor law?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/656@16/: Do you plan to attack Charles Evans Hughes's stance on preparedness and war with Europe, and if so, how?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/680@17/: Do you plan to support the Jones Act -- granting greater autonomy to the Philippines along with a plan to grant independence.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/682@18/: Would you support American participation in a postwar League of Nations, if one were to be created after the current War?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/689@19/: Do you have any statements to make about the Federal Trade Commission, established in 1914?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/695@20/: Do you believe that certain groups in the United States, for their own narrow interests, are trying to undermine American diplomacy and the global order?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/696@21/: Will you make any statements about the increased regulation of narcotics and stimulants such as a cocaine, which began with the 1914 Harrison Act?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/681@22/: Do you support the recently ratified 17th Amendment, requiring the direct election of U.S. Senators?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/691@23/: Are you willing to meet with German-American and Irish-American political leaders to discuss your beliefs, regardless of your feelings towards their organizations?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/questions_json/697@24/: Where will you travel to during your final days before the election?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4328@0/de: I encourage every state to expand the suffrage to women as soon as possible.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4327@1/de: I support the passage of a Constitutional amendment protecting the right of women to vote.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4238@2/de: Under my first term, we have accomplished more progressive reform than under decades of Republican rule, in spite of any promises which that party may be making now.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4239@3/de: We will take the attack to the Republican Party this fall -- it is impossible to satisfy the demands of both wings of that party, and Hughes must surely cast his lot with one and alienate the other.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4240@4/de: My speech fill focus on our success in avoiding the war in Europe, along with a promise that we will continue to take every effort to avoid provocation in that theatre.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4241@5/de: Much as changed, but I stand as committed to the ideals of the New Freedom as I was in 1912. I will be circumspect about committing the country to further federal legislation, beyond that which we have achieved during my first term.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4242@6/de: I intend to announce new restrictions on foreign travel and shipping which will greatly reduce the chance of incidents with Germany, and thus reestablish a true neutrality in this war.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4243@7/de: I am proud to have kept this country out of war, and I will make every effort to do so if elected for a second term.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4244@8/de: I don't intend to explicitly rebuke such claims, but I will not emphasize the peace issue as I campaign this fall.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4245@9/de: I pray for peace, but we will not compromise the rights of American shipping and commerce. We are fully prepared to take the fight to Germany if interference continues.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4246@10/d: A vote for Mr. Hughes is a vote for war. He was an admirable Justice, but he is sympathy with the most bellicose elements of the Republican Party.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4247@11/d: I don't plan to say much about Charles Evans Hughes one way or the other. I believe we have better things to campaign on.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4248@12/d: We have taken extensive efforts to increase the military preparedness of the United States. For Mr. Hughes and others to insinuate otherwise is simply false.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4249@13/d: I'm prepared to stand behind Louis Brandeis as a Court nominee. He has devoted his life to fighting for the common man against the business trusts of this nation.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4250@14/d: Brandeis's ability is not in question, but he is too radical to be considered for a Court opening. I'd also rather not have the Jewish issue come up during this campaign.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4251@15/d: I will speak about the FTC at every opportunity, and waste no effort at implying that its work has only just begun at the present point.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4252@16/d: I hope to hit on the theme of reform and progressivism frequently during our campaign. This is a great chance to do that.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4253@17/d: In a few cases, we did have to go a little further than the New Freedom ideals would imply, but we plan to take a more moderate course during my second term.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4254@18/d: Why Roosevelt continues to press such an unpopular point in his speeches is beyond me, but we will certainly waste no chance to attack him and Hughes on the issue.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4255@19/d: Roosevelt is still a popular figure, particularly among the type of progressive voter we hope to attract. I will refrain from any explicit criticism of his statements.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4256@20/d: We will dispatch a military expedition to Mexico, with clear orders to continue their pursuit regardless of any interference that may arise from the nation's Carranza government.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4257@21/d: I will dispatch a military expedition into Mexico to apprehend Pancho Villa. The expedition will operate in any area where the Carranza government does not have control.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4258@22/d: We need to mobilize the National Guard and increase our military presence on the southern border, in order to prevent future attacks.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4259@23/d: As I've thought of this issue more, I now believe it makes sense to support it. It will be politically expedient and morally correct to do so.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4260@24/d: I won't take any active steps to support or oppose this measure, but I will not wield the veto if Congress passes it.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4261@25/d: My position on this system has not changed -- I cannot support the creation of a federal program to lend money directly to farmers.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4262@26/d: I will spare no effort to assist our nation's unions in their struggle with the railroads, including direct intervention if necessary.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4263@27/d: I believe a fair course would be to press for legislation requiring an 8-hour workday for railroads, along with other compromises.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4264@28/d: I don't see a need to take an active role in arbitrating this labor conflict. Let the unions and railroads work out a solution between themselves.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4265@29/d: I will sign this reluctantly. I support the income tax increase on higher incomes, but not the introduction of a tariff commission. Such a commission will invariably be too friendly to big business in its recommendations.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4266@30/d: I'm proud to sign this into law. I think the broad majority of Americans can stand behind its provisions.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4267@31/d: I will veto this Act. I support a federal income tax, but not to the level that this bill imposes. It also introduces an estate tax and an excess profits tax.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4268@32/d: I want to campaign this fall on the passage of a child labor law. I will personally appeal to any recalcitrant Senators, to consider the electoral success of Democrats this fall.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4269@33/d: I would certainly sign this into law, but not if that means railroading a bill through Congress against the wishes of its elected members.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4270@34/d: Newton Baker is the best man for the job. Regardless of any political gossip, the President needs a reliable working partner as Vice President.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4271@35/d: Newton Baker is the progressive choice for Vice President, and I have every confidence in his abilities.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4310@36/d: I would prefer that the measure grant immediate independence, but I can support it in its current form.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4311@37/d: This is a necessary step forward in the self-determination of the Philippines.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4312@38/d: This measure is premature at the present time. We have added greatly to the welfare of the Philippines and should not leave before our work is done.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4313@39/d: This Amendment is a necessary reform in the functioning of our government, and removes a significant avenue of corruption from our electoral process.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4314@40/d: Regardless of personal feelings, this Amendment obviously went through a stringent ratification process and reflects the overwhelming majority of the people.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4315@41/d: I believe that Senators should be elected by the legislature of each state, in line with the original Constitution.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4316@42/d: I support a League of Nations, and American participation in it. We can no longer safely ignore the affairs of the world.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4317@43/d: I don't have any comment on this plan. It's far too early to determine how the war will end, who will win, or what the peace arrangements might be.

en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4323@47/d: If we're so bent on avoiding war, why are we expanding the Army and contracting for new weapons?
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4329@48/d: I don't plan to address women's suffrage in this campaign. There are more important issues at hand.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4330@49/d: I stand opposed to the expansion of women's suffrage.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4331@50/d: I believe that the prohibition of alcohol would be a positive benefit for our country.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4332@51/d: It would not be wise, at this point, to make any statements supporting or opposing prohibition in our campaign. There are too many people on both sides of this issue.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4333@52/d: We reject any call for the prohibition of alcohol, and I would not support such laws as President.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4334@53/d: I support the Federal Reserve in general, but I believe that we should have established a more centralized, federal government bank.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4335@54/d: Before this act, our country caromed from one financial panic to the next. The Federal Reserve is a tremendous step forward.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4336@55/d: The Federal Reserve idea is worthy of support, but I would prefer that private banks were given a larger role in its operation.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4337@56/d: I believe the Federal Reserve was an unnecessary and destabilizing change to the nation's banking system.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4338@57/d: I support the Federal Trade Commission and will take a broad interpretation of its power over the next four years.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4339@58/d: The Federal Trade Commission is a necessary step forward for reform in this country.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4340@59/d: Some steps were needed to curtail abuse by business, but the Commission has far too much power over legitimate, honest businessmen in this country.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4341@60/d: I support the Clayton Antitrust Act and would hope to see further measures enacted to protect the rights of labor in this country.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4342@61/d: I don't plan to give this act more than cursory mention as I campaign. There are better issues to focus on.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4343@62/d: I don't believe that we should have one set of laws for business, and another for unions. This act is another example of federal overreach.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4344@63/d: I can think of no better way to reinforce my commitment to peace and neutrality than to meet with such groups.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4345@64/d: During my career, I have met with any number of individuals whom I have disagreed with. I don't see a need to apply a different standard to this situation.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4346@65/d: I refuse to meet with any hyphenated-American group which places another identity above that of American.

en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4357@67/d: I do, and I would especially single out German-Americans in this regard, for their support of an expansionist German state.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4358@68/d: I do, and I would especially single out Irish-Americans in this regard, for their strenuous opposition to Great Britain.
en.1916_Wilson_Baker/answers_json/4359@69/d: I'm concerned about any citizen who would embrace the presence of a hyphen in their American identity.
